notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one card in hand.
You control at least one basic land.
description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Sphinx's Disciple, untapping a basic land you control.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Immobilizing Ink by paying {1} and discarding a card, untapping Sphinx's Disciple.
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
